title: ControlScope: Workflow Revision and Reliability in LLM Agents
title_zh: ControlScope：LLM 智能体中的工作流修订与可靠性
abstract_en: How much of a running workflow should a language model agent revise? ControlScope compares continuing generated code, editing the next tool call's data arguments, and replacing the unfinished workflow from the same public execution state. The nested permissions separate available repairs from the actions an agent selects. We evaluate one-time and repeated reviews across filesystem tasks, ALFWorld, and AppWorld. Across two source programs per task and three reasoning-reviewer draws on 20 filesystem tasks, FULL completes 15-16 tasks versus 13 for KEEP; across four fast draws it completes 10-13 versus 13. Fresh student-record confirmation reproduces a batch-read repair. ALFWorld fast panels yield KEEP/ARG/FULL scores of 85/86/87 on 87 tasks across 52 scenes and 134/134/127 on 134 tasks across four scenes; reasoning on the 87-task cohort also yields 85/86/87 with substantial review cost. An AppWorld V1 official-test panel of 585 task instances from 195 scenario templates shows small net differences. Frozen replays expose viable agent-written replacements interrupted by later revision in two failed file-organization runs. An offline source-trajectory midpoint comparison shows later reviews completing an insufficient repair. Five-call protection saves 19.4% of logged model output and loses one success across 20 fresh source runs. An argument-only shortcut shows that the broader sampled policy can overlook a cheaper successful edit available in both operation sets. These outcomes tie repair access to actual choices and subsequent execution.
abstract_zh: 本文研究运行中的语言模型智能体应当修订多大范围的工作流。ControlScope 比较三种嵌套式修订权限：继续生成代码、编辑下一次工具调用的数据参数，以及从同一公开执行状态替换未完成工作流。该设计将“可用的修复范围”与“智能体实际选择的动作”分离。作者在文件系统任务、ALFWorld 和 AppWorld 上评估一次及多次复核。结果显示，扩大修订权限有时能提升成功率，但收益依赖模型采样、复核成本和后续执行；在部分失败案例中，后续复核甚至会中断原本可行的智能体替代方案。离线轨迹分析还表明，较晚复核可能完成此前不足的修复。五次调用保护可减少 19.4% 的模型输出，仅损失 20 次新鲜源运行中的一次成功。总体而言，工作流修复能力不能仅由权限范围衡量，还必须结合智能体的实际选择及其后续执行结果。
key_points_zh: ControlScope 将工作流修订权限划分为 KEEP、ARG 和 FULL：继续代码、修改下一工具调用参数、替换未完成工作流。
在文件系统任务和 ALFWorld 中，FULL 偶尔优于 KEEP，但不同采样方式下优势不稳定，并伴随更高复核成本。
修复权限与实际策略选择并不等价：智能体可能忽略更便宜的参数编辑，也可能因后续复核破坏原本可行的替代方案。
离线轨迹分析显示，较晚复核能够完成先前不足的修复；AppWorld 官方测试中的总体差异则较小。
限制最多五次调用可节省 19.4% 的模型输出，仅牺牲少量成功率，说明成本控制与可靠性之间存在可调折中。

llm_assessment.comment: ControlScope directly analyzes executable workflow revision granularity and provides valuable evidence for reliable agent repair and review policies.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: ControlScope直接研究可执行工作流的修订粒度，为可靠的Agent修复与审查策略提供了有价值的证据。
